name: Instant Drops
description: Kills drop their reward after {{tenths}} tenths of a second instead of the usual 20 (two seconds).
author: KSFA

settings.label: Wait before the reward drops
settings.help: 0 drops it the moment the enemy dies. 10 is one second. 20 is what the game ships with. Whole tenths only - the game stores this as one byte multiplied by 0.1.

patches.description: Item Drop Delay Time: {{tenths}} tenths of a second
